name: @xo/capability-contract
description: Projects a compiler-discovered XOIR capability (plus any linked reasoning nodes) into a portable SemanticCapabilityContract, and resolves that contract to an executable implementation via a small, extensible set of BindingResolvers. Depends only on @xo/xoir and @xo/types, so it is importable by both @xo/compiler (which builds contracts) and @xo/runtime (which resolves/executes them) without either depending on the other.
